N-3.4-A.skill: differentiate sums of inverse trigonometric functions whose chain factors cancel or add.

N-3.4-B.skill: apply an inverse trigonometric derivative to an unspecified inner function given only values of g and g′.

N-3.5-A.skill: diagnose the first incorrect step in a worked derivative that mixes product, quotient and chain rules.

N-3.5-B.skill: combine product, quotient and chain rules with tabulated values of unspecified functions, evaluating each derivative at the correct input.

N-3.6-A.skill: find a second derivative of a composite or product of unspecified functions by applying the chain and product rules twice.

N-3.6-B.skill: find and interpret the second derivative of a function defined implicitly, substituting dy/dx before evaluating.
